Pilot gear & bags

10 small aviation gifts for pilot coworkers

Coworker gifts work best when they are easy to accept, easy to carry, and not overly personal. A modest aviation reference can acknowledge someone’s interests without guessing at their equipment or home decor. These ten ideas suit a thank-you, team exchange, or small workplace celebration.

By Pilot Gift Guide Updated 2026-10-20

How we choose our recommendations
In this guideThe ideasHow to chooseMore gift ideas

The ideas

Our selections prioritize personal relevance, usefulness, and fit for the recipient. Named products and destinations link to official sources where applicable.

  1. 1

    Aircraft greeting card

    A specific handwritten thank-you gives a simple card real value. Mention what the person helped with rather than relying on a generic slogan.

  2. 2

    Small notebook

    Choose a useful size with an understated cover. It should work at any desk, even if the recipient prefers to keep aviation out of work.

  3. 3

    Airport postcard set

    Pick places connected to a shared project or journey. Blank cards can be used later instead of becoming permanent display clutter.

  4. 4

    Quality everyday pen

    A straightforward pen is easy to use without special setup. Avoid engraving unless you are certain of the preferred name and spelling.

  5. 5

    Individually wrapped treats

    Confirm dietary preferences and workplace rules first. A small amount of something they enjoy is better than an oversized novelty hamper.

  6. 6

    Aircraft bookmark

    This suits a known reader and takes almost no space. Choose a slim design that will not damage pages or strain a book’s spine.

  7. 7

    Desk-sized calendar

    Select the correct year and a layout the recipient can use. Aircraft photographs should be a bonus, not a substitute for readable dates.

  8. 8

    Simple luggage tag

    A neutral tag can be useful for travel without becoming intimate. Let the recipient fill in their own contact information.

  9. 9

    Coffee invitation

    Offer a relaxed coffee at a convenient time. A genuine thank-you conversation can be a better fit than another object.

  10. 10

    Team message collection

    Collect short notes for a departure or milestone. Keep participation optional and focus on shared memories the recipient will appreciate.

How to choose

Follow your workplace’s gift rules and the agreed budget. Keep humor friendly and avoid private flight details, alcohol assumptions, and expensive equipment. If you do not know the recipient well, choose something usable or consumable and leave personalization minimal.

Prices and availability can change. Check the exact model, delivered total and return terms with the seller. Our recommendations are researched editorial selections, not hands-on test results.
